about: Lettering fonts bundled with Genko Studio (native/resources/fonts/). F1 (2026-11-13): the files, licences, provenance and coverage. F2 (2026-11-14): this file is the program's catalogue (embedded in genko_core, core/font_catalog). The six fonts of storage "embedded" are compiled into the program (native/resources/genko_text.qrc); the forty of storage "file" are installed beside it (share/genko-studio/fonts) and a book that names one says the feature fonts@1. fallback: the face that draws what a kana-only or partial face lacks. lookalike: this face's own swaps for a mark it lacks. vertical.presentation_forms: the cmap holds every vertical bracket form (U+FE35… U+FE44, U+FE47, U+FE48) the vertical setting asks for; false: the horizontal bracket is turned.

google/fonts.note: every file was fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at this commit and its git blob id checked against the commit's tree; each family's OFL.txt is copied verbatim to licenses/<family dir>-OFL.txt

coverage_rules.checked_with: fontTools 4.68.0 (cmap, GSUB, vhea/vmtx) and FreeType 2.14.3 (Pillow 13.0.0) opening every file
coverage_rules.kana_complete: every code point of ぁ–ゔ (U+3041–3094), ァ–ヶ (U+30A1–30F6, small kana and ヴ included), ー (U+30FC), ゛ (U+309B) and ゜ (U+309C) is in the cmap
coverage_rules.kana_missing: what is missing of U+3041–3096, U+30A1–30FA, ー, ゛, ゜ (so the rare ゕゖヷヸヹヺ are listed but do not clear kana_complete)
coverage_rules.punctuation: 、。「」『』！？…―～・; punctuation_missing lists exact misses, punctuation_missing_after_lookalike what is still missing after the app's look-alike swap (― → — U+2014, ～ → 〜 U+301C; render/text/fonts.cpp kLookalike)
coverage_rules.kanji: full = every JIS X 0208 level-1 kanji, every jōyō kanji and at least 99 % of level 2; none = no level-1 or level-2 kanji; partial = anything else. Numbers: level 1 of 2,965, level 2 of 3,390, jōyō of 2,136 (Unihan 17.0 kJoyoKanji; for 𠮟・塡・剝・頰 the usual form 叱・填・剥・頬 also counts)
coverage_rules.vertical: supported = a GSUB vert feature and vhea/vmtx tables are present (vrt2 is recorded separately); presentation_forms = measured by native/tests/unit/test_font_faces.cpp through FreeType's cmap
